pairs.reason: Classification and CrawlError intentionally share the page-outcome Literal prefix; the test_crawl_error_members_derive_from_classification invariant pins the shared members and the documented pipeline-only additions.

The two docstrings declaring one security contract -- SSRF-safe manual redirect handling (F1) and sensitive-header stripping on cross-domain redirects (Fix 3) -- still mirror each other, and that mirror is now the whole of the clone. The executable tails the fetchers used to duplicate (decompress under a size cap, persist Set-Cookie, lowercase headers, build the result) were folded into fetchers._finish_fetch, which both call, and the content encoding is read there rather than at each call site. The docstring mirror stays on purpose: a reader arriving at either fetcher should find the contract stated where they are, and the two bodies no longer back it separately. What is still duplicated in executable code is the redirect loop, deliberately: the curl_cffi copy must release a busy curl handle on four distinct abandon paths (H1/N5/N8) and awaiting that release is the hang being escaped, so the loops are not yet interchangeable and folding them would move the incident knowledge behind a seam rather than remove it. The guard stays the shared fetcher arity, which is the property a further fold of the redirect loop would have to preserve; the folded tail is guarded separately by tests/test_safety_invariants.py::test_response_cookies_enter_the_jar_only_through_the_fetch_tail.

Tavily, Brave and Serper each parse the body, test the status, raise SearchProviderError and then funnel into _collect_results. The error contract is repeated per provider where one shared parse-and-check would do, so the three sites can drift apart silently: a provider can start reporting a different message or stop funnelling and the other two say nothing. Sanctioned so the repetition stays visible until it is folded into a single helper all three call; the guard is the error the providers must keep raising, with its detail intact.
